description: Land Acquisition - Hewelwela, Bibila D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for road improvement. It contains descriptions of land lots, extents, claimants, and encroachers/prior owners, which falls squarely under the "Land and property-related matters" category (Type 4). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
